{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rayter Sector Resource Analysis Committee''' was responsible for declaring that the native [[Human/Legends|Humans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]] were not advanced enough to be awarded equal status with other [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]] populations. They recommended annexing the planet into the sector under the corporate control of [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]].<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
